title: Cyber Shield X Packet State Transitions
description: Deterministic state machine shared by both implementations. Transitions are only valid when all preconditions hold; invalid transitions are rejected WITHOUT modifying state.

states.CREATED: Packet freshly synthesized by the deterministic scenario generator.
states.INSPECTING: Packet reached the inspection gate awaiting the detection engine.
states.HOLDING_INTERCEPT: Packet is suspicious: frozen at the gate until an operator acts.
states.ALLOWED: Terminal. Packet released through the gate.
states.DROPPED: Terminal. Packet discarded at the gate.
states.ESCALATED: Terminal. Packet promoted to a local incident; history preserved.

invariants: A HELD packet never moves during pause or resume until a terminal decision (APPROVE/DROP/ESCALATE) is applied.
Duplicate operator actions on the same packet are rejected (idempotent).
Terminal packets are removed from active simulation storage while retaining bounded event history.
Counters are updated exactly once per valid terminal transition.
